2607.11358.title: RefineEvo: Planning-Guided Heuristic Evolution with Bidirectional Experience
2607.11358.paper_summary: Automatic Heuristic Design (AHD) has emerged as a transformative approach for solving combinatorial optimization problems. While recent Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods have shown promise, they predominantly rely on fixed evolutionary operators and struggle to effectively accumulate and reuse historical search experience. This paper proposes RefineEvo, a novel evolutionary framework that transforms AHD from a static trial-and-error process into a planning-guided, experience-driven system. RefineEvo introduces a Planner to dynamically schedule evolutionary operators and trigger refinement based on the current search state, and a Reflector to distill valuable lessons into a Bidirectional Experience Pool containing both positive insights and negative pitfalls. This synergistic framework enables the system to adapt its search tools to the evolving complexity of the problem and leverage trajectory-aware, situation-conditioned insights to guide generation. Experiments on several classic combinatorial optimization benchmarks demonstrate that RefineEvo consistently outperforms strong baselines. In particular, RefineEvo delivers superior solution quality while improving token efficiency, enabling more efficient and autonomous heuristic design.
2607.11358.paper_summary_zh: 自動啟發式設計（AHD）已成為解決組合優化問題的變革性方法。儘管最近基於大型語言模型（LLM）的方法顯示出潛力，但它們主要依賴於固定的進化運算子，並且在有效積累和重用歷史搜索經驗方面面臨挑戰。本文提出了RefineEvo，一種新穎的進化框架，將AHD從靜態的試錯過程轉變為一個以規劃為指導、以經驗為驅動的系統。RefineEvo引入了一個規劃者，用於根據當前搜索狀態動態調度進化運算子並觸發精煉，還有一個反思者，將有價值的教訓提煉到一個雙向經驗池中，該經驗池包含正面的見解和負面的陷阱。這一協同框架使系統能夠根據問題不斷變化的複雜性調整其搜索工具，並利用軌跡感知的情境條件見解來指導生成。在幾個經典的組合優化基準上進行的實驗表明，RefineEvo始終超越強基線。特別是，RefineEvo在提高解決方案質量的同時改善了令牌效率，使得啟發式設計更加高效和自主。
